## Hi, I'm Aaron 👋

The home page is the ten-second version. This is the longer story — write it in
your own voice.

I came to data science from a background in environmental science and a passion for using data to drive sustainable practices. What keeps me here is the thrill of uncovering insights from complex datasets and the opportunity to make a positive impact through my work.

At Willamette my focus has been on data engineering and analytics, with a particular interest in applying machine learning techniques to real-world problems. My [capstone](capstone.qmd) is where that comes together.

### Beyond the terminal

- 🌲 I enjoy hiking, exploring the outdoors, and baking.
- 📚 I'm currently learning about advanced machine learning techniques and their applications in environmental science.
